detail.longDescription: Introducing Boole-1.7B, a 1-bit version of Qwen3-1.7B. Boole-1.7B retains 85.9% of BF16 performance using 247MB (13.9x smaller). It outperforms 1-bit Bonsai-1.7B and similar-sized LFM models, and nearly matches 1.58-bit Bonsai-1.7B. It’s intended for low-latency tasks using English and non-thinking mode. To learn more, - Blog: https://precisionnumerics.ai/blog/boole-1p7b - Weights: https://huggingface.co/precision-numerics/Boole-1.7B - Chat in browser: https://precisionnumerics.ai/chat/ We're going to ship more capable models soon for the open-source community. Let us know what models/capabilities you want to see next!
